metadata.purpose: Phase 3 enrichment-readiness baseline — the 5 metrics Phase 3 will improve against
metadata.status: FRAMEWORK_READY — metrics defined; awaiting population from a live Phase 2 run. Run the reRunCommand against a real scrape output (e.g. data/Restaurant_Toronto_*.json) to capture measured values. The script computes all 5 metrics from the standard scraper JSON export.
metadata.note: This file is the Phase 3 before/after comparison anchor. Each metric below records its definition + the Phase 3 sub-phase that improves it. Measured values are null until a live dataset is fed through scripts/phase3-baseline.js. Re-run after each Phase 2 scrape to refresh.

phoneFormatDiversity.definition: Distinct raw phone display formats before E.164 normalization (e.g. '+1 (416) 555-0100' vs '4165550100' vs '(416) 555-0100')
phoneFormatDiversity.target: Phase 3.1 collapses all formats to a single E.164 representation (phone_e164) + classifies type (mobile/landline/toll_free/voip/invalid)

addressCompleteness.definition: % of businesses with a full (3+ component) vs. partial address before structured parsing
addressCompleteness.target: Phase 3.2 parses every address into structured street/city/state/postal/country + geocodes to verified lat/lng

duplicateRate.definition: Estimated same-business-listed-twice count (exact name+phone match — a lower bound; fuzzy duplicates are higher)
duplicateRate.target: Phase 3.3 uses fuzzy matching (fuse.js on name+address+phone) to catch near-duplicates and merge into business_duplicates

emailAvailability.definition: % of businesses with a website (the surface Phase 3.5 mines for emails)
emailAvailability.target: Phase 3.5 discovers candidate emails (info@/contact@/hello@ + page scrape) and SMTP-verifies them

websiteLiveness.definition: % of websites returning HTTP 2xx (live) — dead/redirected sites are web-agency leads
websiteLiveness.target: Phase 3.6 records website_status_code + website_liveness (live|dead|redirected|error) + detects tech stack

testCountAtBaseline.note: Frozen at Phase 2 milestone (v2.0.0-phase2). Track net-new tests across Phase 3 against this number. Phase 3.0 adds 0 net-new tests (stubs + schema only); implementations in 3.1–3.13 add tests per sub-phase.
